topic: Auto-Dreamer Hugging Face public-publication chronology versus imported repository commit chronology

sources.observed_claim: arXiv records Auto-Dreamer v1 on 2026-05-20 02:03:34 UTC.
The current repository history displays an initial commit and core ScienceWorld train/test files dated May 2, with evaluation-selection artifacts dated May 5-6.

The author activity surface reports uyffg/auto-dreamer as a dataset publication roughly 19 days earlier, auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public as a model publication roughly 18 days earlier, and dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60 as a model publication roughly 17 days earlier. These relative activity labels are post-May-20 at the observation time.
The checkpoint-bridge repository is public but has no model card on the checked surface.
The ScienceWorld dreamer repository is public, reports Safetensors/Qwen3, 15B parameters and BF16, but has no model card on the checked surface.

The current eval_splits tree lists sciworld_split_1per_K10_evalAll.jsonl (74.5 kB), sciworld_split_5per_K10_evalAll.jsonl (373 kB), and sciworld_split_v2_9type_10per_K10_eval10.jsonl (75.2 kB). Direct blob fetches for row-level content returned cache misses in this run.
The current fixed_val_sets tree lists sciworld_qwen3_8b_sorted_9cat_per10_evals6_seed42.jsonl (2.59 MB). Direct row-level blob fetch returned a cache miss in this run.

findings.summary: The May-dated Hugging Face git history cannot by itself establish that the Auto-Dreamer dataset was publicly available before the May 20 arXiv submission: the current author activity surface separately reports the dataset publication event only roughly 19 days before this Aug 29 observation. The safe interpretation is content-history chronology, not public-availability chronology, until a Hub creation/publication timestamp or independent archival witness resolves the discrepancy.

The checkpoint-bridge and dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60 public model surfaces are reported by the author's Hub activity as publications roughly 18 and 17 days before this Aug 29 observation, respectively, so they are post-paper public surfaces. They can still serve as retrospective bridge candidates, but cannot independently attest paper-time public availability or evaluated-run identity.

Current eval_splits/fixed_val_sets tree metadata is visible and confirms concrete ScienceWorld selection artifacts and sizes, but row-level content remains unavailable through the checked cached web route; deterministic derivation of the paper's seven-type/660 frozen episode stream therefore remains unresolved.

scope_guard: Do not infer malicious backdating or exact repository creation time from the discrepancy. Hugging Face git commit dates can reflect imported local history, while activity labels reflect Hub events; only conclude that commit dates alone do not prove public availability. Do not infer artifact nonexistence from blob/tree cache misses. Do not equate current 11-bank/9-type/fixed-val selection files with the paper's 7-type/660 online-evaluation stream without row-level derivation evidence.
